rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a contradiction, especially a logical inconsistency or conflict.

example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 cin4 hau6 jau5 maau4 teon5

rows.note: Use this for the act of contradicting or rebutting someone or a proposal.

example.english: At the meeting, I rebutted the proposal by pointing out a contradiction.
example.traditional: 我喺會上反駁咗呢個建議。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 wui6 soeng6 faan2 bok3 zo2 ni1 go3 gin3 ji5
